_metadata.object: lever -> surrogate-output response map (everything varies jointly)
_metadata.method: Every statistic is marginal over the other 66 inputs, drawn jointly over their sampled range [0,1]; nothing is held at BAU. change_0_to_1: median paired change when the input moves 0 -> 1, over 2,000 real hypercube trials, with p10/p90. share_of_variance: Sobol total-order index (share of the output's variation across the explored space attributable to the input, interactions included). depends_on_other_inputs: S_T - S_1, the part of that share that exists only in combination with other inputs.
